_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: "The input" is the message input [data-testid="message-input"]; "the picker" is the skill picker [data-testid="skill-picker"]; its options are its [role="option"] elements; "the chip" is [data-testid="skill-chip"]. On a phone, the skills picker fills the space above the composer and keeps typing focus in the input. The page lists MCP servers web and library, each with a tool "search", and locked, whose tools fail to load. window.pickerBox() returns the picker's bounding box as JSON {x, y, width, height}; window.pickerPlacement() returns JSON {"top": its top relative to the visual viewport, "gap": the gap from its bottom down to the input's top}, both rounded. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/skills. 2. Fill the input with "/skills " (with the trailing space). 3. The input should have focus, and the picker should contain no search box: [data-testid="skill-picker"] [role="searchbox"] count 0. 4. The picker's top should come to be 12 to within half a pixel: eval Math.abs(JSON.parse(window.pickerBox()).y - 12) < 0.5 with expect "true". 5. Its height must be more than 420: eval JSON.parse(window.pickerBox()).height > 420 with expect "true". 6. Type "a-long-skill-query-that-wraps-across-multiple-lines" into the input key by key (a type step, not fill; the input keeps focus). 7. The picker should contain "No matching skills". 8. Eval window.pickerPlacement() and JSON.parse it: its top should come to be 12 (eval JSON.parse(window.pickerPlacement()).top with expect "12"). 9. Tap the "No matching skills" text in the picker: a touch step "start" on it immediately followed by a touch step "end". 10. The input should have focus, and the picker should be visible. 11. Fill the input with "/skills " (with the trailing space), then type "draft-review" key by key. 12. There should be exactly one option, containing "draft-review", and the input should have focus. 13. Resize the viewport to 393x500 (set_viewport width and height only). 14. Eval window.pickerPlacement() with expect "{\"top\":12,\"gap\":6}". 15. The picker's height must be more than 200: eval JSON.parse(window.pickerBox()).height > 200 with expect "true". 16. Click the picker's "Close skills" button (button[aria-label="Close skills"]). 17. The picker should become hidden (or absent), and the input should have focus.
